objective: Follow the clones' trail west across the sea to the Ashen Pass
title: Ash on the Wind
summary: Asahi catches up with you on the burned island, and the clones' trail turns into a patrol.

steps.title: Ashen Pass
steps.sub: Where the old fires never quite went out

say: You ran here on the water too? Good. I thought I was the only one stupid enough.

lines: Resealing the vault. She said she'd meet us at the shrine by midnight, and that we're not to do anything brave before then.
So, obviously, we're going to do something brave before then.
Clone footprints in the ash. Fifty, maybe more. They don't sink like people do. Look, they barely touch it.

say: My mother walked this pass once, when the fires were still burning. She said the ash remembers every footstep.
She came home. She always came home. Until the one time she didn't.
Anyway. That's why I'm loud. If I'm loud, people remember I was here.

lines: Asahi. Something's moving above the road.
A patrol. Fire and earth, the way the thief likes them. Let's make some footprints of our own.
Not bad. You didn't even need me. I needed me, though. That was fun.
Look up the pass. The shrine.
Lanterns. In a shrine nobody's prayed at for twenty years.
Someone's waiting for us. Let's not keep them.
